creature.deepcharter.tally_approach: Clicking behind you, counting. A Tally has found your ore.
creature.deepcharter.tally_clamp_pod: A Tally has clamped to the cargo hatch. Drill into rock to cut it off.
creature.deepcharter.tally_clamp_foot: A Tally has clamped to your pack. Strike it.
creature.deepcharter.tally_broken: The Tally comes apart. It drops nothing.
creature.deepcharter.tally_sample: The Tally took one %s as a quality sample, and is gone.
creature.deepcharter.approach: Something walks toward the pod. Light the pod, or be ready to drill.
creature.deepcharter.grab: Something has hold of the hull. Drill into rock to cut it off, or get out and strike it.
creature.deepcharter.dead: It is gone. The hull is clear.
creature.deepcharter.drifter_pod: A pale glow drifts toward the drill, hissing. Stop drilling and it will pass.
creature.deepcharter.drifter_foot: A pale glow drifts toward the sound of you. Stand still and it will pass.
creature.deepcharter.spores: Spores are eating the hull. Drive clear.
creature.deepcharter.alarm_foot: The hollows are awake. More will come to the sound of you.
creature.deepcharter.foot_approach: Something walks toward you in the dark. A light in your hand keeps it off.
creature.deepcharter.foot_grab: Something has hold of you. It slows you and eats at your hunger. Strike it off.
creature.deepcharter.foot_dead: It is gone. You are free of it.
creature.deepcharter.foot_first: The Retained come to anyone in the dark with no light in hand. One that holds you slows you as if you carried ore and drains your hunger down to a floor, never to starving. It never hurts you. It lets go only when it is killed, by a blow from you or a crewmate. A light in hand keeps one off, but does not free you once it has hold.
